research_question: Does a forecast of target-relevant future evidence improve route choice over an independently trained current-view scorer given exactly the same candidate routes?

endpoint_measurements: sum of unique counts capped per episode at the required quota
executed deviations and their temporal relationship to encounters and reports
operating_conditions.interpretation: Five previously examined baseline failures are a development comparison. Independent hosted VLM calls may diverge even without a route intervention. Exact route-to-report causation requires evidence beyond a final count.

natural_test.unit: Physical start nested in held-out house
natural_test.supervision: Number of distinct new instances reaching an eligible reporting viewpoint within a fixed action budget; exclude instances already eligible at the start.
